subject: TeamCode/sim/shooter-brain-testbed.html
reason: The browser sim is a deliberate JavaScript twin of the Java stages so students can run it with no toolchain; the spec string is the shared contract and ShooterBrainTest.everyRegisteredStageParsesWithDefaults plus the sim's own parser round-trip guard both sides. Decided 2026-10-26.

subject: TeamCode/src/main/java/org/firstinspires/ftc/teamcode/shooter/ShooterConfig.java
reason: The placeholder table lets the OpModes initialise and the sim export compile before calibration night; TeleOp prints an UNCALIBRATED warning while it is in use (ShooterConfig.usingPlaceholderTable) and CalibrationStore replaces it from the hub. Decided 2026-10-26.

subject: TeamCode/src/test/java/org/firstinspires/ftc/teamcode/shooter/ShooterBrainTest.java
reason: The sim is a standalone HTML file students open from disk, so its stage table cannot be a build artifact; the test reads the DEFS block and the embedded parity vectors at one place each, and parity-vectors.txt is the behavioural chokepoint both sides run. Decided 2026-10-26.
